name: Icicles in the Wind
source:
While trying to give her adopted daughter the perfect Christmas, Sophie must also plan a funeral for a close family friend. Her friend Justine helps her work through the grief.

[From [url=https://witchydev.itch.io/icicles-in-the-wind]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
苏菲在努力给她的养女过一个完美的圣诞节的同时，还必须为一位亲密的家庭朋友筹办葬礼。她的朋友贾斯汀帮助她度过悲伤。

[来自[url=https://witchydev.itch.io/icicles-in-the-wind]Itch.io[/url]]
